docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Chekhov's stories of provincial Russia, in Constance Garnett's translation.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Anton Chekhov (1860–1904), short stories (Russian), translated by Constance Garnett (1861–1946), 1916–1922. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
